description: Read the ordered turns of the most recent conversation between the agent and one customer. Each turn carries its turn_id, conversation_id and the observed steps - LLM calls with a preview of the model output, and tool calls with the tool name, input and output - plus latency and status where available. Use it to see why the agent answered the way it did. Malformed records, and tool responses that cannot be matched to a tool call, may be missing. This list is CURSOR-PAGINATED: it returns {data, paging} - page with the `after` cursor from paging.cursors, and stop when paging carries no `next` link, because a page can be empty and still have more after it.

after.description: Cursor - return the page immediately after it.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

before.description: Cursor - return the page immediately before it.

end_timestamp_ms.description: Only turns that started at or before this Unix time in milliseconds.

limit.description: Maximum entries per page. A page can be shorter.

start_timestamp_ms.description: Only turns that started at or after this Unix time in milliseconds.

user_phone_number.description: The customer: a phone number in digits only with the country code (15551234567, no + or separators), a Business-Scoped User ID such as US.2788620304833812, or the conversation_id returned by test_agent. Prefer the BSUID for a customer who has ever used a WhatsApp username - their phone number may be unknown, which returns Consumer not found.

name: mba_get_conversation_turns

outputSchema.description: A paginated list of conversation turns

data.description: This array represents the page of data returned

items.description: A single turn of a conversation with its observed steps

conversation_id.description: App-scoped opaque identifier for the conversation containing this turn

e2e_latency_ms.description: Elapsed time, in milliseconds, from when the agent receives the customer message that starts the turn until the agent finishes producing its response, including model and tool-call processing time, if available

message_id.description: WhatsApp Cloud API message ID for the customer message that started the turn, reconstructed for the authorized consumer identity when available

steps.description: Ordered steps observed during the turn

items.description: A single step observed during a conversation turn

latency_ms.description: Latency for the step in milliseconds, if available

llm_output_preview.description: A truncated preview of the model output, for LLM calls

status.description: The step status: SUCCESS, ERROR, or TIMEOUT. Known values: SUCCESS, ERROR, TIMEOUT.

tool_input.description: The input arguments passed to the tool, for tool calls

tool_name.description: The name of the tool used by this step, for tool calls

tool_output.description: The output returned by the tool, for tool calls

type.description: The type of step: LLM_CALL or TOOL_CALL. Known values: LLM_CALL, TOOL_CALL.

timestamp.description: Timestamp of the turn in milliseconds since epoch, if available

next.description: URL of the next page as issued by Meta

previous.description: URL of the previous page as issued by Meta

title: Read conversation turns
